5 Battles That Shaped American Independence

Click a pin on the map to learn about a battle. Standard: Key Idea 7.3d

Dot = battle location · Blue = American win · Red = British win
How to use this site
  • Use the Battles menu to open each battle's page.
  • Each page has a painting, a simple battle map, and a chart.
  • Check the Timeline, then take the 10-question Quiz.

The Battles: Overview

Five battles from 1775 to 1781. Compare them, then click one to learn more. Standard: Key Idea 7.3d

Losses in each battle (estimates)

"Losses" means soldiers killed, wounded, or captured. All numbers are estimates. Historians do not agree on exact counts.

Who won? (win/loss summary)

The Americans lost 2 of these 5 battles. They still won the war. Losing a battle did not always mean losing the war.

Timeline, 1775–1783

The 5 battles in order. Gray boxes are key events that help explain the battles. They are not battles. Standard: Key Idea 7.3d
